title: CircCramp1l targets the miR-532-3p/HMGB1/Drp1 axis to regulate allergic rhinitis.
authors: Zhang, Yalin; Wang, Jiangang; Song, Yilan; Chai, Jingmei; Li, Liangchang; Jin, Hainan; Yang, Yi; Wang, Chongyang; Jin, Yongde; Yan, Guanghai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究circRNA/miRNA/HMGB1/Drp1轴调控过敏性鼻炎，虽含HMGB1-Drp1蛋白互作的MD模拟，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: The pathogenesis of allergic rhinitis (AR) remains incompletely understood, and the role of circular RNAs (circRNAs) in its progression warrants further investigation. This study aimed to elucidate the underlying mechanisms of circRNA-mediated regulation in AR and identify potential therapeutic targets. By collecting nasal mucosa specimens from AR patients, establishing house dust mite(HDM)-induced AR mouse models and human nasal epithelial cell(HNEpCs) models, and combining circRNA/miRNA sequencing with GEO data analysis, it was found that HDM triggers a significant upregulation of circCramp1l in AR. Mechanistically, circCramp1l acts as a ceRNA to sponge miR-532-3p, thereby relieving the suppression of HMGB1, an response-related DAMP molecule. Further validation through dual-luciferase reporter(DLR)assays, Co-IP combined with mass spectrometry, and molecular dynamics(MD) simulations demonstrated that HMGB1 directly binds to Drp1(binding free energy DeltaG = -480.02 kcal/mol; key domain: amino acids 86-164 of HMGB1), driving Drp1 Ser616 phosphorylation. This leads to excessive mitochondrial fission, ROS accumulation, P2X7R/TLR4/NLRP3 axis. This signaling cascade induces Th2 polarization(elevated IL-4/IL-5/IL-13), eosinophil infiltration, and epithelial damage. Intervention experiments showed that conditional knockout of HMGB1, silencing of circCramp1l, administration of miR-532-3p mimics, or treatment with the Drp1 inhibitor Mdivi-1 all reversed mitochondrial dysfunction and significantly alleviated AR symptoms. This study reveals that the circCramp1l/miR-532-3p/HMGB1/Drp1 signaling axis contributes to AR pathogenesis by modulating mitochondrial dynamics and P2X7R/TLR4/NLRP3 axis. These results offer a novel target for the diagnosis and treatment of AR.
abstract_zh: 过敏性鼻炎（AR）的发病机制尚未完全阐明，环状RNA（circRNAs）在其进展中的作用值得进一步研究。本研究旨在揭示circRNA介导的调控在AR中的潜在机制，并识别可能的治疗靶点。通过收集AR患者的鼻黏膜标本，建立屋尘螨（HDM）诱导的AR小鼠模型和人鼻上皮细胞（HNEpCs）模型，并结合circRNA/miRNA测序与GEO数据分析，发现HDM在AR中触发circCramp1l的显著上调。机制上，circCramp1l作为ceRNA海绵吸附miR-532-3p，从而解除对HMGB1（一种反应相关DAMP分子）的抑制。通过双荧光素酶报告基因（DLR）实验、Co-IP结合质谱分析以及分子动力学（MD）模拟进一步验证，HMGB1直接结合Drp1（结合自由能DeltaG = -480.02 kcal/mol；关键结构域：HMGB1的氨基酸86-164），驱动Drp1 Ser616磷酸化。这导致线粒体过度分裂、ROS积累以及P2X7R/TLR4/NLRP3轴的激活。该信号级联诱导Th2极化（IL-4/IL-5/IL-13升高）、嗜酸性粒细胞浸润和上皮损伤。干预实验显示，条件性敲除HMGB1、沉默circCramp1l、给予miR-532-3p模拟物或使用Drp1抑制剂Mdivi-1治疗均能逆转线粒体功能障碍，并显著缓解AR症状。本研究揭示circCramp1l/miR-532-3p/HMGB1/Drp1信号轴通过调节线粒体动力学和P2X7R/TLR4/NLRP3轴参与AR发病机制。这些结果为AR的诊断和治疗提供了新靶点。
